---
title: "Variables"
---

```{r, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(collapse = TRUE, comment = "#>")
```

The full cross-org variable dictionary: every variable documented in
the data dictionaries of candidate- and catalogued-tier packages,
searchable in one table. Use the search box to find every documented
variable across the organisation.

```{r}
library(owdata)

DT::datatable(
  owd_variables(),
  rownames = FALSE,
  filter = "top",
  options = list(pageLength = 50)
)
```
